calculation_handling.description: The lawful number of loading spaces of a lawfully existing building replaces the required number when it is lower.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the as-built count of lawful loading spaces for the existing building.

calculation_handling.description: Exemption from additional loading spaces for a change of use of a lawfully existing non-residential building is not modelled.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the first storey coverage of the existing building and the change of use.

units.disclosure: Whether additional loading spaces are exempt on a non-residential change of use depends on the existing first storey covering at least 75% of the lot area; this is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition that the lawful number of loading spaces is not reduced is not modelled.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the as-built count of lawful loading spaces and the proposed change.

units.disclosure: The condition that the lawful number of loading spaces is not reduced is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: An addition or extension must meet Clause 220.5.10.1 or obtain a minor variance; not evaluated.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the existing building and the proposed addition.

calculation_handling.description: The lawfully existing number of loading spaces may not be reduced on a change of use; not modelled.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the as-built count of lawful loading spaces and the proposed change of use.

units.disclosure: The rule that the lawfully existing number of loading spaces may not be reduced is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Additional loading spaces required by Clause 220.5.10.1 must be provided or a minor variance obtained; not evaluated.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the existing building and the proposed change of use.

calculation_handling.description: Regulation 220.5.10.1(8) does not apply to a transportation use along Eglinton Avenue West and East.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the list of lots along the named streets and the use of the building.

220.5.10.11(1).explanation: A lawfully existing building that has fewer loading spaces than required keeps its lawful number as the minimum.

220.5.10.11(2).explanation: A lawfully existing non-residential building changing to a use other than a dwelling unit needs no additional loading spaces if its first storey covers at least 75% of the lot and its lawful loading spaces are not reduced.

220.5.10.11(3).explanation: An addition or extension to a lawfully existing building must provide the additional loading spaces required by Clause 220.5.10.1 or get a minor variance.

220.5.10.11(4).explanation: When a lawfully existing mixed use building changes use, its lawful loading spaces cannot be reduced and any additional spaces required by Clause 220.5.10.1 must be provided or authorized by minor variance.

220.5.10.11(5).explanation: The loading space table for other select uses in 220.5.10.1(8) does not apply to a transportation use along Eglinton Avenue West and East.
